# Vimeo
> Vimeo is an all-in-one video platform for creating, hosting, managing, sharing, and streaming professional video.

Vimeo serves creators, entrepreneurs, and businesses with ad-free hosting, customizable playback, live events, collaboration, analytics, AI-powered workflows, and developer tools for integrating video into products and websites.

## Core Platform Features
- [Features overview](https://vimeo.com/features): Overview of Vimeo’s video creation, hosting, collaboration, and streaming capabilities.
- [Online video hosting](https://vimeo.com/features/online-video-hosting): Ad-free HD video hosting with privacy controls, fast delivery, and sharing tools.
- [Video player](https://vimeo.com/features/video-player): Customizable embeddable player with branding controls, chapters, and accessibility support.
- [Video library](https://vimeo.com/features/video-library): Centralized video storage with organization, permissions, and searchable content management.
- [Video editor](https://vimeo.com/features/video-editor): Browser-based editing tools for trimming, branding, captions, and quick video production.
- [Vimeo AI](https://vimeo.com/features/vimeo-ai): AI tools for generating, editing, translating, and improving video workflows.

## Creation, Recording, and Editing
- [Create](https://vimeo.com/create): Video creation workspace with templates and guided tools for making business videos.
- [Screen recorder](https://vimeo.com/features/screen-recorder): Record screen, webcam, and audio for demos, updates, and training videos.
- [Teleprompter](https://vimeo.com/features/teleprompter): Built-in teleprompter tools for recording polished talking-head videos more easily.
- [Video editor](https://vimeo.com/features/video-editor): Edit clips, add text, resize formats, and prepare videos for publishing.
- [Stock library](https://vimeo.com/stock): Browse and license stock footage for creative and commercial video projects.

## Hosting, Management, and Sharing
- [Video hosting](https://vimeo.com/features/online-video-hosting): Secure hosting for publishing, embedding, and distributing videos without ads.
- [Video library](https://vimeo.com/features/video-library): Organize large video collections with folders, metadata, and team access controls.
- [Video privacy](https://vimeo.com/features/video-privacy): Control who can watch, embed, download, or access videos.
- [Video collaboration](https://vimeo.com/features/video-collaboration): Review and approval workflows with time-stamped comments and version sharing.
- [Video analytics](https://vimeo.com/features/video-analytics): Track plays, engagement, geography, and viewer behavior across hosted videos.

## Live Streaming and Events
- [Live streaming](https://vimeo.com/features/livestreaming): Broadcast live events with branded players, simulcasting, and audience engagement tools.
- [Webinar](https://vimeo.com/features/webinar): Host interactive webinars with registration, live chat, Q&A, and on-demand replay.
- [Virtual events](https://vimeo.com/features/virtual-events): Run online events with branded experiences, sessions, and attendee participation features.
- [Recurring events](https://vimeo.com/features/recurring-events): Manage repeat live programming and scheduled broadcasts for ongoing audiences.
- [Enterprise live streaming](https://vimeo.com/enterprise): Enterprise-grade live video workflows, security, and support for organizations.

## OTT and Monetization
- [OTT overview](https://vimeo.com/ott): Launch branded streaming services for subscription, rental, or purchase-based video businesses.
- [Vimeo OTT pricing](https://vimeo.com/ott/pricing): Pricing and plan information for launching and scaling OTT streaming services.
- [Sell videos online](https://vimeo.com/ondemand): Monetize videos through rentals, purchases, and direct-to-audience distribution.
- [Subscription video services](https://vimeo.com/ott): Build subscription streaming apps and channels across web, mobile, and TV.
- [Branded apps](https://vimeo.com/ott): Publish white-label streaming experiences with custom branding and platform distribution.

## Developer and API Resources
- [Developer site](https://developer.vimeo.com/): Central hub for Vimeo API documentation, SDKs, and developer guides.
- [API reference](https://developer.vimeo.com/api/reference): Reference documentation for Vimeo’s REST API endpoints and resources.
- [API overview](https://developer.vimeo.com/api/start): Introduction to authentication, requests, and core Vimeo API concepts.
- [SDKs](https://developer.vimeo.com/api/sdk): Official and community SDK resources for integrating Vimeo in applications.
- [Player SDK](https://developer.vimeo.com/player/sdk): Tools and documentation for controlling and embedding the Vimeo player.
- [Player API](https://developer.vimeo.com/player/sdk/reference): Reference for player methods, events, and embed customization options.

## Help Center and Support
- [Help Center](https://help.vimeo.com/): Support articles for account management, uploading, playback, billing, and troubleshooting.
- [Vimeo plans](https://help.vimeo.com/hc/en-us/categories/12489985230097-Plans-billing-and-membership): Help articles about plans, billing, and membership management.
- [Uploading and managing videos](https://help.vimeo.com/hc/en-us/categories/12489985714641-Upload-create-and-manage-videos): Guidance for uploading, organizing, and editing videos on Vimeo.
- [Live events help](https://help.vimeo.com/hc/en-us/categories/12489986036753-Live-streaming-and-events): Support documentation for live streaming, webinars, and event workflows.
- [Embedding and player help](https://help.vimeo.com/hc/en-us/categories/12489985808017-Embed-and-share): Articles covering embeds, sharing settings, and player customization.
- [Developer support](https://help.vimeo.com/hc/en-us/categories/12489986118801-Developers-and-APIs): Help resources for API usage, authentication, and developer troubleshooting.

## Solutions and Use Cases
- [Vimeo for business](https://vimeo.com/business): Video tools for marketing, communications, training, and team collaboration.
- [Vimeo Enterprise](https://vimeo.com/enterprise): Enterprise video platform with advanced security, governance, and large-scale deployment support.
- [Marketing](https://vimeo.com/solutions/marketing): Use video for campaigns, lead generation, and branded customer experiences.
- [Corporate communications](https://vimeo.com/solutions/corporate-communications): Internal video workflows for announcements, updates, and executive messaging.
- [Learning and development](https://vimeo.com/solutions/learning-development): Training and educational video solutions for onboarding and knowledge sharing.
- [Events](https://vimeo.com/solutions/events): Video tools for live events, webinars, and virtual audience engagement.

## Blog and Learning Resources
- [Vimeo blog](https://vimeo.com/blog): Articles, announcements, product updates, and video strategy insights from Vimeo.

- [Product updates](https://vimeo.com/blog/category/product-updates): News about new Vimeo features, releases, and platform improvements.
- [Customer stories](https://vimeo.com/customers): Case studies showing how organizations use Vimeo for video workflows.
- [Watch](https://vimeo.com/watch): Curated viewing destination for videos, creators, and featured content on Vimeo.
